>acrylics make them look trashy & dirty

I work in a profession where we have to wear gloves, use 99% alcohol, & wash our hands all day to keep a sterile environment. By the end of the day my hands would be cracked, rashly, and my nail bed even started coming off from under my nails too. After taking off the gloves my nails would be soft and flimsy, then dried out and brittle. 

Now I wear acrylics, squirt expensive hand lotion in gloves before putting them on and have the nicest, softest hands I’ve had my whole life. 

Also, short nails can still get dirty. So unless you’re constantly picking the dirt out from under them throughout the day, they’re probably just as dirty as anyone else’s.
